class.name: VoxelSculptData
class.description: In chunks of 16 cubed voxels: a shape added and one cut away from what lies below, a small offset (smoothing), and a material. Saved uncompressed, one byte array per chunk.

method.name: get_chunks_in_box
method.description: The chunks covering the box, by chunk position; a chunk with no changes is an empty array. Pass it back to [method set_chunks] to undo.

method.name: set_chunks
method.description: Replaces the given chunks (as [method get_chunks_in_box] returns them); an empty array removes one.
